kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تقترعون (form VIII)
# تَقْتَرِعُونَ (taqtariʕūna) /taq.ta.ri.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
# تُقْتَرَعُونَ (tuqtaraʕūna) /tuq.ta.ra.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
